{{Quote|Wilyem, are you&mdash;''"<br />"''Yessss. Wilyem in the tail.|Allana Solo and Wilyem, preparing for their mission|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
'''Wilyem''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in the [[New Jedi Order]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Wilyem and fellow Barabel [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zal]] and [[Dordi]] flew with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] as he [[Toydarian double-reverse spinner|distracted]] [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] forces, while his wife, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], smuggled four [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] Jedi offworld to keep them from falling into Galactic Alliance control. During the mission, Wilyem operated as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]{{'s}} tail. Later, in [[44 ABY]], Wilyem began a nest hidden in the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] with Zal, as well as Dordi and Sebatyne's son, [[Tesar Sebatyne|Tesar]]. Soon afterward, the Jedi Order left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to lure the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] as part of a trap, but the Barabels remained behind with their nest. When the Jedi sprung their trap, the Sith retreated into the Temple, and [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]]&mdash;granddaughter of Han and Leia Solo, who had accidentally discovered the Barabel nest previously&mdash;had a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] of the nest coming under attack. The Solos traveled back to Coruscant and [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|battled]] the Sith in the Temple to warn Wilyem and the other Barabels. The Barabels were safely extracted from the Temple with their [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] aboard the ''[[Parting Gift]]'', [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by ex-[[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]].

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Sebatyne|Now that you have seen the nest&mdash;|Zal|<nowiki></nowiki>''And'' the eggz.|Sebatyne|And the eggz, you must stay for the hatch.|Allana|Two ''months''? Mom will ''kill'' me!|Wilyem|Better Jedi Solo than ''this'' one.|attr=Tesar Sebatyne, Zal, Allana Solo, and Wilyem|src=<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Leia-fotj.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Leia Organa Solo]]
Wilyem was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]]. He [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] with the [[New Jedi Order]] and achieved the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], an [[Force psychosis|enigmatic madness]] began to befall several young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knights, causing them to believe that everyone they knew had been replaced by impostors. The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] decided to deal with the issue by [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|imprisoning]] the psychotic Jedi Knights in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. The Jedi Order resented this, however, and secretly kept as many of the ill Knights as possible hidden in the [[New Jedi Temple]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be studied. To prevent [[Galactic Alliance Security]] forces from discovering these Jedi and encasing them in carbonite, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his wife, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], decided to smuggle the Jedi offworld. Wilyem, along with fellow Barabel Jedi Knights [[Dordi]] and [[Zal]], served as [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] for Han Solo and his granddaughter, [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]], aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. It was their job to [[Toydarian double-reverse spinner|distract]] Galactic Alliance forces in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Coruscant while Organa Solo smuggled the four Jedi who had been captured by the Order&mdash;[[Seff Hellin]], [[Natua Wan]], [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]], and [[Bazel Warv]]&mdash;to [[Shedu Maad]] in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].<ref name="Abyss" />

The ''Millennium Falcon'' broke every procedure for departing the planet, attracting the attention of the Galactic Alliance [[Nargi-class pursuit frigate|''Nargi''-class pursuit frigate]] ''[[Fast Death]]''. After failing to respond to the ''Fast Death''{{'s}} warnings, they were also set upon by [[Bolt Squadron (Galactic Alliance)|Bolt Squadron]], a [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] of [[XJ5 X-wing starfighter]]s. Solo flew the ''Millennium Falcon'' behind [[PharmCom Orbital Processing Plant One]], a pharmaceutical production facility in orbit over Coruscant, and the ''Fast Death'' stayed behind, to be replaced by another pursuit [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], the ''[[Quick End]]''. Solo then ordered Allana to alert [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] and proceeded to tell Dordi and Zal to bring up their guns and targeting computers as a bluff. He then added that only Wilyem would be allowed to shoot, but he wasn't allowed to hit anything.<ref name="Abyss" />

Master Sebatyne then arrived with a squadron of [[StealthX]]s and targeted Bolt Squadron. Meanwhile, at Solo's orders, Wilyem fired a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] out of the aft docking bay. It detonated a few kilometers to their stern, and Solo pretended that they had just suffered a hull breach from a Galactic Alliance torpedo. As he corkscrewed the ''Millennium Falcon'' toward the ''Quick End'', pretending to be out of control, he revealed to the ''Quick End''{{'s}} command that he had Allana&mdash;disguised as his adopted daughter "Amelia"&mdash;on board. The ''Quick End'', finally convinced that Solo wasn't pulling a trick, maneuvered out of his way and broke off all Galactic Alliance pursuit as Solo gave Allana the order to reach out with the Force to Organa Solo, who quietly smuggled the four Jedi Knights offworld in the ''[[Gizer Gut]]''. Wilyem, the Solos, Dordi, and Zal jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to meet up with the Jedi at Shedu Maad.<ref name="Abyss" />

In [[44 ABY]], Wilyem began a nest hidden in the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple's]] underlevels with Zal, as well as Dordi and Tesar Sebatyne. They were accidentally discovered by Amelia and her friend, Jedi Knight [[Bazel Warv]], one of the Jedi that Wilyem had helped smuggle offworld, and who had since recovered and returned to Coruscant. The Barabels insisted that the two had to stay at the nest until their eggs hatched, so that they would remain hidden, and their eggs would be safe. Amelia, however, suggested that they trade secrets&mdash;she told them the truth of her identity; that she was Allana, the daughter of the Jedi [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]], and the heir to the [[Hapan]] throne. The Barabels agreed that the secret was important enough, and allowed Amelia and Warv to leave.<ref name="Vortex" />

Soon afterward, the Jedi decided to leave the planet in an attempt to lure the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|emerging]] [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] into a trap. Wilyem and the three other nesting Barabels stayed behind; but when the Jedi decided to spring their trap and [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|assail]] the Sith, the Tribe pulled back into the Temple. Meanwhile, Allana had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of the Barabels' [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] being [[Death/Legends|killed]], and she returned to Coruscant and located the nest&mdash;along with her [[Parent/Legends|grandparents]], the Jedi Knight [[Zekk]], the hapan [[Taryn Zel]], and several Hapan [[Commando/Legends|commandos]]&mdash; to warn them about her vision. Wilyem was initially wary, but the trespassers revealed that they had wanted to drop off Warv to warn them, but they had been [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|ambushed]] and Warv had been killed.<ref name="Apoc">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>

The Barabels then returned to the nest to gather their younglings, and then fought their way out of the Temple, killing several Sith along the way&mdash;although many commandos and some of the younglings were also killed. They were then met by the former [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] in the ''[[Parting Gift]]'', along with Master Saba Sebatyne, former Jedi Knight [[Tahiri Veila]], and [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant Major]] [[Gef Olazon]]. Wilyem, Dordi, Zal, Tesar, and their younglings&mdash;of whom twenty remained&mdash;were all safely extracted from the Temple.<ref name="Apoc" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Allana_Solo.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Allana Solo]]
{{Quote|Nobody is going to eat our eggz. This one will be here to make sure that never happenz.|Wilyem|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
As a Barabel, Wilyem shared a sense of humor with other members of his [[Species/Legends|species]] that other beings rarely understood. Much of what was said between the crew of the ''Millennium Falcon'' was taken as a joke between the three Barabel Jedi, who remained high-spirited throughout the mission, even when it seemed that there would be trouble.<ref name="Abyss" /> When Amelia and Warv stumbled upon the Barabel nest, Wilyem and the other Barabels were outraged, and decided to force the two to stay until their eggs had hatched. When Amelia complained that her adoptive mother would kill her&mdash;figuratively&mdash;Wilyem responded sincerely that it was better if Organa Solo killed her than if he did. Like the other Barabels, Wilyem was very protective of his nest, and he stated that he would never let anyone eat their eggs. When Amelia proposed her trade of secrets and told the Barabels that if they revealed her secret, she would likely be dead within a [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Wilyem and the others agreed to the terms and let the two intruders go.<ref name="Vortex" /> Wilyem was very wary of Allana when she returned with more trespassers, but after she had explained herself, Wilyem took her vision very seriously.<ref name="Apoc" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Nobody'' gets to shoot. Well, except maybe Wilyem. But not until I say so&hellip;and you ''can't'' hit anything. Clear?''"<br />"''Of course I can hit something. I'm a ''Jedi''.|Han Solo and Wilyem|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Wilyem learned the ways of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] with the Jedi Order and completed his training, ascending to the rank of Jedi Knight. He was an accomplished gunner and was the only one of the three Barabel Jedi Knights that Solo allowed to open fire during their mission to smuggle the Jedi offworld.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wilyem was created by author [[Troy Denning]] for his [[2009]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', his first installment, and the third book overall, in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. He later appeared briefly in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]'' and ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'', the sixth and ninth novels in the series, also by Denning.
